x: It is good to see our girls in action again thanks to Harry Porter and Dave Sharpe. Individually Gail Porter leads the way with 3rd in the Southern Counties WAAA Girls Championship.

Two team wins in this meeting with a rejuvenation of our girl's team thanks to the hard work of Harry Porter and Dave Sharpe. With an Australian team competing we had little hope of individual honours.
Thanks for this must go to David Sharpe for his guidance and support. On the track side the junior sprint squad has grown in numbers led by Jessica Palmer and Andrea Coore.

Words, cannot express my gratitude for the work done by Harry Porter and David Sharpe. Our circuit training sessions started later than we intended, but thanks to the help of Merton Council we were able to use a School gymnasium in Wimbledon.
Also for his efforts in the Walks, thanks must go to Dave Sharpe, who has turned up at Battersea Park from Dagenham despite having a number of problems during the summer.
